question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Be the best, more better than the rest.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the phrase "**more better than**".
 
• **"Better" **is already a comparative form, so using** "more"** with it is** redundant and incorrect.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**better than**", ensuring grammatical** correctness and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Be the best**, better than **the rest."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Be the best,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
 
• **Option 4: "the rest."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
